answer: The shale index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 100 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zenith. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the nebula queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 298 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
